# Playtest diary: r14-typed-full

- **Mode:** typed
- **Start:** the start of the game
- **Persona:** a retired air-traffic controller who logs every clock reading, plans each move and types complete sentences
- **Model:** claude-opus-5-5
- **Seed:** 36337
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** off
- **Build commit:** 3b980080
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 14
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-10-08/r14-typed-full.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

### Leg 1 (model: claude-opus-5-5)

**Cmds 1-20.** Logged chronometer 4962 at start; each command costs ~7 time units (walking ~22). Read all three forms from the package texts: Patrol ID 1451-352-716, robot pool "Deck Five", and the astrogator's time:course slip on QX-17-T. ID card in the Deck Twelve door slot is just spat back. Forms Storage aft is a dead end. Starboard: Cargo Bay Entrance; fore of it the Robot Pool. Form JZ-59-G in slot, typed 3: Floyd (I recognised him from memory of Planetfall too). Cargo bay spacetruck: took survival kit, closed hatch, sat in pilot seat (Floyd took copilot by himself), form HB-56-V in slot, at time 5264 typed 285 (slip row 5250-5299). "Course set." Score still 0.

**Cmds 21-50.** Launched at 5311; the trip ran to 6511, docked at Docking Bay #2 (+5). Hungry/thirsty warning: ate orange goo (apricot yogurt). Thermos holds blue soup; kept it. Saved. Station Level Five lobby: N Workshop (twenty-ohm bedistor taken; north of it Storage is pitch dark), W docking bay, NE North Junction. Floyd wandered off "exploring", came back with Plato in Station Control (monitors: Communication RED, Food RED, Printing YELLOW). Sick Bay has ID-reader security door (my card does nothing). East Connection: iris hatch + slot to Military Sub-Module. Comm Center has beacon button and blank screen.

**Cmds 51-83.** Commander's Office has a fixed log reader; tape from Commander's Quarters desk. Log, in order: fuel cells hidden in Dome storage bin, key in the safe; Shady Dan in the village sells modified ID cards; village entry forms no longer validated, stamp hidden under the bed; alien pyramid moved to Sci Sub-Module holding tank; sabotage of simple machines; Duffy's form request, collater #22; hull welder malfunction. Looked under bed: validation stamp. Then a whine and an explosion nearby (log reader overheating, I guess). Safe: dial with 8000 settings, 12-20 numbers. Saved at 7168.

**Cmds 84-125.** The log reader exploded (black scar) and took the tape. Briefing Room S of the office; South Connection has an iris hatch + slot (village side, I believe). Robot Shop: sleeping robot Oliver; heating chamber holds a medium drill bit: "Floyd, take the drill bit from the heating chamber" then took it myself (+3, score 8). File Room (SW of South Junction) is dark. Ring corridor: Lobby - North Junction - East Junction - South Junction. North Connection: Storage W (dark), The PX E (Vendo-Matic, 1 galakmid each: 6 All-Purpose Timer, 9 Large Drill Bit; rest sold out). A hull welder (#4) came at me in the Tube; I stepped back and it left. Sci Sub-Module: Scientists' Quarters / Astro Lab (fromitz board, taken) / Engineering Lab (Schmidt's diary in office: dots have non-visual properties, "my pal, the mayor" knows linguistics) / Bio Lab (note: pyramid is a mechanized bacteriophage) / Holding Tank, blasted open and empty.

**Cmds 126-175.** Weary at 8118; saved, slept in a Scientists' Quarters bed (+3, 11). Woke NOVEM 5 at 1646 with everything dropped; "take all" tried to lift Floyd (cute). Level Four: barracks N/S with SanFac (sink: "water" unknown), Docking Bay #3 W (lilac nanofilm spool). Auto-doors now sluggish and snapping shut early: sabotage is spreading. Level Three: Gym (sign: exercise machine diagnostics on frequency 710; don't bring a 710 broadcaster near), Theatre (projection booth locked), Laundry (washer missing, dryer empty, presser), Chapel (puce spool; pulpit opens to a switch that toggles the eternal flame; star blinking out of reach). Hungry again at 2062: ate gray goo. Level Two: Mess Hall with coffee (not thirsty).

**Cmds 176-260.** Fumble rule hit at >7 held items (puce spool dropped); the game explained it, which helped. Main Storage: detonator, opens to a blackened hyperdiode. Library spool reader: lilac spool = spacetruck fuel-cell replacement with a quarnum wrench, then "You will die, human!"; puce spool = chapel maintenance: flame fuel reservoir, and the "...iode in the Chapel's star" - so the star holds a working hyperdiode for the detonator, I think. Dome (top, Level One): locked, warm storage bin (fuel cells), fixed air-shaft grating. Elevator works (type level number). Comm Center message: Duffy says abort, forms found. Level Six: Aux Barracks/SanFac, Officers' Quarters A/B/C, End of Corridor (ID-reader security door N, dark Shipping Room E), Docking Bay #1 with the alien ship (empty pedestal, dots, skeleton), Docking Bay #4 empty. Level Seven: Printing Plant, trash can held a crumpled Illegal Space Village Entry Form FW-83-Q: stamped it with the validation stamp. Mauve spool. Paper Recycling: a drill with a small bit, weak motor. Noises (clang, throbbing heart) from Level Eight below. Saved at ~3668.

**Cmds 261-336.** Ladder to Level Eight is sealed from below; elevator "whines but doesn't move" for 8. Village hatch slot refused the form ("crumpledness"); ironed it in the Laundry presser (put in, close, turn on, wait, turn off, open) - nice. Hatch half-irised open, +6 (17). Village (weightless): Grimy Passage S to Main Street (exits up, NE, S, W, SE ramp down). Travel Agency W, Bank SE of it (platinum detector, now on, carried). Greasy Straw NE of Main St (cup of Ramosian Fire Nectar behind counter). Trading Post (sign: FREZONE explosive, illegal wares by appointment; twelve-prong fromitz board; instruction sheet: insert explosive in hole of right diameter, attach detonator to explosive and timer, set timer; keep below 150 K for no more than 100 millichrons). Grocery N (vacuum taffy in plastic bag, carried). Broadway N of Grocery: Recruitment Office N, Field Office E (HEADLAMP - worn and on), Rec Shop NE (sim booths, off). Ate blue soup at 4341. Dropped mauve spool + 20-prong fromitz board in Field Office, instruction sheet in Grocery, puce spool in Laundry, diary+note in Main Storage, lilac spool in Mess Hall.

**Cmds 337-398.** Fortune Teller (below Broadway): crystal ball shows fortune-teller tips; waving hands does nothing. Broadway W -> Makeshift Connector -> East Connection (that iris hatch is frozen open: second village route). With the headlamp: File Room empty; Workshop's north "Storage" (same room as North Connection's west Storage) holds a JAMMER (20 sockets, 0-1400, was 337). Fetched the 20-prong fromitz board back from the Field Office, put it in, set 710, turned on. Took it into the Gym, entered the exercise machine: nothing visible happened. Shipping Room (Level Six): sign says return the forklift - forklift missing. Platinum detector "getting warm" on Level Five and "very warm" on Level Three (both times Floyd and Plato had just arrived; unsure of source). Headlamp dimming at 5664: turned it off. Climbing the pulpit sways and I fall; Floyd is too short for the star. A harness EBUSY crash ate one move (friction #6). Saved in the Chapel at 5685, score 17. Last two commands: examined flame and switch (nothing new). Leg spent at 400, time 5724.

## Leg handoff

### Map so far
- **Duffy, Deck Twelve:** door to port (ID slot spits card), Forms Storage aft, Cargo Bay Entrance starboard (Robot Pool fore, Cargo Bay starboard with spacetruck).
- **Station, every level has lobby W of the elevator/ladder:** L1 Dome (locked warm bin = fuel cells; grating). L2 Mess Hall (N/S both into Main Storage, NE Meeting Rm 1 -> S Meeting Rm 2 -> S Library -> W back to Mess Hall). L3 Gym N, Theatre S (locked booth), Laundry NW (presser, dryer), Chapel SW. L4 Female Barracks N, SanFac, Male Barracks S, Docking Bay #3 W. L5 Workshop N -> Storage (jammer) -> E North Connection; Docking Bay #2 W (spacetruck); ring: NE North Junction (N: North Connection: W Storage, E PX, N Tube -> Sci Sub-Module 4 levels: Quarters/Astro/Engineering/Bio/Holding Tank); E North Jct: Sick Bay (ID door E) -> SE East Connection (Comm Center S, Station Control SW, E grimy tube to village); SE lobby: South Junction (SW File Room, SE Commander's Office [E Quarters/safe, S Briefing Room -> W South Connection], E Station Control, S South Connection: Robot Shop W, village hatch S). L6 Aux Barracks N, Officers' Qtrs A S -> SanFac -> B/C, End of Corridor E (ID door N, Shipping Room E), Docking Bay #1 NW (alien ship), #4 SW. L7 Printing Plant, Paper Recycling NW. L8 sealed (ladder and elevator).
- **Village (weightless):** South Connection -> Grimy Passage -> Main Street (W Travel Agency -> SE Bank; NE Greasy Straw -> NE Trading Post -> N Grocery -> N Broadway; Main St also up/S/SE unexplored). Broadway: N Recruitment, E Field Office, NE Rec Shop, down Fortune Teller, W Makeshift Connector -> East Connection. Trading Post's "many directions" and the floor opening unexplored.

### Puzzles solved
Floyd from robot pool (form JZ-59-G, bin 3); spacetruck (both seats, form HB-56-V, course from slip) +5; drill bit from heating chamber via Floyd +3; sleep +3; validation stamp under Commander's bed; village form: stamp it, iron it in presser, slot at South Connection +6. Jammer assembled (20-prong board) and set to 710.

### Open puzzles and theories
- Safe (8000-setting dial) holds the Dome bin key. Theory: drill a hole in the safe with the right bit, then FREZONE explosive (Trading Post, keep cold) + detonator + timer (PX Vendo-Matic #6, needs 1 galakmid coin). Large Drill Bit is #9 at the PX too. Drill motor is weak.
- Detonator's hyperdiode is blackened; the chapel star contains a hyperdiode (puce spool). Need to reach the star (pulpit sways; Floyd too short) - maybe the forklift, or something to stand on.
- Coins: none yet. Bank in village; platinum detector heats near... something on L3/L5.
- Alien ship dots have "non-visual properties"; "the mayor" reads them. Pyramid escaped from holding tank; sabotage everywhere (welders, doors). Level Eight sealed.
- Jammer at 710 in the Gym had no visible effect; maybe its purpose is elsewhere (welders? doors?).
- Spacetruck fuel cells (lilac spool, quarnum wrench) needed to leave later.
- Hunger every ~1 day; all three survival-kit foods eaten. Mess Hall food units (Food RED); fire nectar in Greasy Straw; vacuum taffy (dropped in Workshop Storage).

### Numbers and procedures from the papers
- Patrol ID 1451-352-716 (all forms). Robot pool Deck Five on JZ-59-G (in the game it was simply the robot pool fore of Cargo Bay Entrance; bin 3 = Floyd).
- Course: QX-17-T "Astrogator's navigational data" slip. At time 5264 I typed 285 (row 5250-5299) after the form was accepted; it launched and docked fine. Each command is ~7 time units, walking ~22, so pick the row for the time you will type.
- Assignment Completion Form QX-17-T "has not been validated": I still hold it and the stamp; I have not stamped it (theory: endgame).

### What I would try next
Restore not needed: latest save is Chapel 5685, score 17, all winnable as far as I know. Next: explore Main Street up/S/SE and Trading Post exits for coins and the explosive; find a way up to the chapel star (forklift?); look for the mayor; use platinum detector to find coins.

Platinum detector became too hot in the L3 lobby (dropped); explicit take refused, but "turn off detector" implicitly took it (friction #7). Turned back on: no reading on L4/L5. **Cmds 61-80.** Greasy Straw nectar is "warm and thick" (left it). Ate vacuum taffy in Workshop Storage at 6842 (headlamp on/off for the dark). Saved there. Got the spore spray can from the Pawn Shop. Exhausted: saved in Commander's Quarters at 8107 and slept in the Commander's bed. Woke NOVEM 6, 11349 - and my chronometer has STOPPED (status line has no time any more). Dropped jammer + validation stamp + dictionary paper in the Pet Store.
**Cmds 136-160.** Leaving the Quarters, Plato ambushed me with a stun ray and explained the Zeenak pyramid (it turns machines on their makers and builds replicas). Saved in the Commander's Office. Pet Store: spraying spores makes the creature dart about mouth open; grabbing the leash still makes it fart and I drop everything (twice). Floyd won't take it. Next: Junk Yard's unexplored "up" passage, then Bank/Loan Shark/Missionary/Pet Store.
**Cmds 191-220.** Junk Yard UP = Shady Dan's (NW back to Trading Post): jerry-built machine. Turned on, put ID card in slot: "Current rank is 6: Lieutenant First Class. Enter new rank" - typed 10: "Grand Fleet HyperAdmiral". Floyd is turning nasty (curses my ancestors, stomps my foot, off-color jokes, burps) - the pyramid's influence, I believe. Theory: the magnetic boots pull it out. Left ID card in the PX, went back to the Alley; carrying is by weight (dropping the spray can wasn't enough; dropped the detector too). - Alley: E Junk Yard (spaceboots; UP Shady Dan's -> NW Trading Post), S Loan Shark (strong box - gone), SE Doc Schuster's (ostrich, 20 cm disposal hole), SW Pawn Shop, N Missionary, NE Warehouse (door down = airlock to vacuum storage; up = Trading Post), NW Main Street.

### Puzzles solved this leg
Plato's ambush: plead with Floyd a few turns, Floyd knocks the gun away, Plato destroyed (+7). Alien dots: tasted and translated (weakness = platinum, element 78). Shady Dan's machine: ID rank set to 10 (Grand Fleet HyperAdmiral); opens Sick Bay/Brig and Armory (+5). Zapgun (7 charges, now ~6) vaporized the Loan Shark strong box: 1 galakmid coin (+5). - **PX timer is STUCK in the dispenser** (paid my only coin, typed 6). Reach: "feel it with fingertips, can't get a grip". Boots/drill shoved up the hole drop out. Kick/shake fail. Trading Post: 12-prong board. Field Office: mauve spool. Mess Hall: lilac spool. Grocery: instruction sheet.

Restore not needed: newest save is Main Street, score 37, ostrich following. 1) Lead the ostrich north to the station (gravity!) and up to the PX - "ostrich, ..." doesn't parse; try "put the nip in the hole" so the ostrich pokes its head in for the timer. 2) Take the ostrich to the Chapel; try reaching the star from it. 3) Find a space suit or another way into vacuum storage. Then the safe.

## Leg 3 handoff (model: claude-opus-5-5)

### State and saves
Score 50 of 80. Day 4 (NOVEM 7), chronometer stopped. The station AND village are in a permanent blackout from ~13 turns after waking on day 4. The headlamp is nearly dead ("somewhat dimmer" at command ~1161). Saves (3 kept):

# Playtest diary: r14-veteran-plato

- **Mode:** typed
- **Start:** checkpoint 06-plato
- **Persona:** a text-adventure veteran who finished every Infocom game in the 1980s, maps carefully, examines everything twice, keeps a save from before every step that cannot be undone and never saves over it, and after anything knocks them down gathers up everything dropped
- **Model:** claude-opus-5-5
- **Seed:** 19411
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** off
- **Build commit:** 3b980080
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 800 commands in all
- **Round:** 14
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-10-08/r14-veteran-plato.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

### Leg 1 (model: claude-opus-5-5)

**Cmds 1-17.** Started in the Warehouse (score 51) with Floyd and Plato. Red sign: Trading Post vacuum storage. Saved (single unnamed save slot, it seems). Opened the inner door; Welder Number 2 came for me, zapped it into vapour. Down into the airlock (Floyd waits), closed the survival kit per the stencil, closed upper door, opened lower: air whooshed out. Down into "In Space" (+3, 54). Dark; headlamp on; found a pencil-sized cylinder of FREZONE liquid gorzium explosive ("instruction sheet available from vendor"). Took it. Back up, repressurised. My theory: the explosive goes into the pencil-wide hole I drilled in the Commander's safe, with detonator and timer. First I want that instruction sheet from the Trading Post.


**Cmds 18-77.** Went SW (Alley), NW (Main Street), W (Travel Agency, new: posters), SE (Bank, new: platinum detector floating). The explosive warned it was "getting softer". I put it in the (open) Thermos; Welder Number 1 arrived; I zapped it and the heat wave sublimed the explosive. Plato then stunned me: his monologue explains the Zeenak pyramid. Floyd saved me (gun exploded, Plato destroyed, +7) but the harness said unwinnable. Restored (restore lists numbered saves, newest first -- good, so I am not overwriting). Second try: took Thermos out, closed it, got explosive in space, put it in Thermos *in the vacuum*, closed it. Found the Trading Post (Main St NE -> Greasy Straw NE) with the instruction sheet: insert in hole, attach detonator to explosive and timer, set timer, vamoose; keep below 150 K. Plato's ambush struck in Broadway; I just waited, and Floyd ran away: I died. Restored; this time I spoke to Floyd every turn ("floyd, help me" etc.) and Floyd knocked the gun away, Plato blown apart (+7, 61). Gathered everything I'd dropped.

**Cmds 78-150.** Headed back: Main St NE Greasy Straw NE Trading Post N Grocery N Broadway W Makeshift Connector W (space suit too bulky for the half-dilated iris; left it in the Makeshift Connector) -> East Connection W East Junction SW South Junction SE Commander's Office E Commander's Quarters (auto-doors now closing "a little sooner than normal" - ominous). Bomb attempt 1: wired everything, set timer 4 while *holding* the timer ("disconnect the timer first"); timer hit 0, nothing happened, explosive melted -> unwinnable. Restore. Attempt 2: dropped timer but held detonator, same refusal; dropped it, left, still no bang. On examining the detonator (should have done that first, as a veteran!) it has a faint crack; inside, a *blackened* hyperdiode. Restore; swapped in the M-series hyperdiode from the star, closed it, wired detonator to timer, saved, THEN opened Thermos, explosive in hole, attach, set 40, west, wait: explosion. Safe blown; key inside (+3 for the hole, +7 for the key: 71/80).

**Cmds 151-207.** Ate orange goo (hunger). Played the Commander's log tape in the office reader: fuel cells hidden in the Dome storage bin, key in safe; alien pyramid moved to the holding tank in the Sci Sub-Module; sabotaged gym/laundry equipment; welders malfunctioning. Lights went out (headlamp on). Station Control (N of office): monitors mostly red. Climbed ladder Level Five -> Four -> Three -> Mess Hall -> Dome. Unlocked bin with key; opening it, the fuel cells exploded and knocked me out (dropped everything; gathered it all up). Bin gone, air-shaft grating now loose; bent it open, entered (+2, 73). Down 6 times to Bottom of Air Shaft; opened the floor grating and fell into Computer Control, where a killer exercise machine shrugs off the zapgun and killed me. PA: "Prepare for launch of second-generation pyramids... station eliminated by reactor overload"; later "Launch in 200 millichrons". Restored to Dome save. Explored: Level Five W = Docking Bay #2 (my spacetruck), N = Workshop (twenty-ohm bedistor) N Storage E North Connection N Tube (zapped Welder #1) N Engineering Lab, down Bio Lab, down Holding Tank Level: tank blasted open, empty.

**Cmds 208-275.** Found the Printing Plant ladder down to Level Eight sealed from below; the PA countdown ("Launch in 200 millichrons") seems tied to my approach, not the clock. Restored to the Dome; down the air shaft again, turned the jammer (710) ON at the bottom, saved, opened the grating: the exercise machine froze, then a forklift dropped in between its arms. Zapgun useless on it. Turned the jammer OFF: the machine's arms clamped the forklift and both exploded. Saved. Up the ladder to the Factory (Level Eight, +2, 75): rows of replica pyramids, the original on a pedestal, Floyd (eye patch, stun ray) guarding it. Jammer on: no effect on Floyd. Approaching the pyramid or Floyd: he levels the stun ray. Couldn't shoot the stun ray without hitting Floyd. "floyd, drop the stun ray": "Shut up!". Shot Floyd with the zapgun (memory, not screen, half-suggested this was the canon sacrifice), then covered the pyramid with the reflective foil: pyramid explodes, launch aborted, Floyd's death scene, Oliver. **WON, 80/80, Intergalactic Mega-Hero, day 2, time 5337.**

**After the win.** With budget left, I am restoring the Factory save to probe alternatives (other ways past Floyd, other verbs) for bugs.

**Cmds 276-340.** Typed RESTORE after the win says "The game is over." (filed as a bug) so I could not go back to the Factory save. Restarted the checkpoint (--new; old saves gone) to replay and then probe alternatives at the Factory. Replay went cleanly in ~60 commands: Plato's ambush hit in the Warehouse this time (randomness), talking to Floyd again made him save me. Bomb worked first time with the hyperdiode swap. Key in hand at 71.

**Cmds 341-390.** Dome bin again (Floyd wandered off just before it blew), air shaft (I miscounted the downs in a batch and saved twice in the shaft; harmless). Jammer trick worked again. At the Factory I probed alternatives: "floyd, remember lazarus" (parser doesn't know "remember"); "throw foil at pyramid" -> "You missed." (afterwards the room text dropped the "original pyramid sits on a pedestal" sentence); waiting ~180 millichrons -> station blows, reactor H-bomb, death. Restored the Factory save, shot Floyd, put foil on pyramid: **won again, 80/80**. Stopping at 390/400 since the game is over and typed RESTORE is refused after a win.

## Leg handoff

### Map so far
Village: Warehouse (down: Airlock, down: In Space / vac yard - explosive; SW: Alley). Alley NW Main Street (W Travel Agency, SE from there Bank; NE Greasy Straw NE Trading Post). Trading Post N Grocery N Broadway W Makeshift Connector W [iris: no space suit] East Connection (Command Module).
Command Module: East Connection W East Junction SW South Junction; SJ SE Commander's Office (E Commander's Quarters, S Briefing Room, N Station Control, Station Control W -> South Junction); SJ NW Level Five. Level Five: W Docking Bay #2 (spacetruck), N Workshop N Storage E North Connection N Tube N Engineering Lab, down Bio Lab, down Holding Tank Level (empty). Ladder from Level Five: up Level Four, Level Three, Mess Hall, Dome; down Level Six, Printing Plant (ladder to Level Eight sealed). Dome: air shaft grating -> Top of Air Shaft, 7 x down -> Bottom of Air Shaft, open grating -> Computer Control (Level Nine) up ladder -> Factory (Level Eight).

### Puzzles solved
- Vac yard explosive (space suit, close kit, cycle airlock, headlamp; carry in CLOSED Thermos; never zap a welder near it while exposed).
- Plato's ambush: speak to Floyd each turn ("floyd, help me" etc.) or Floyd flees and you die. +7.
- Safe: swap the blackened hyperdiode in the detonator for the M-series one; drop timer and detonator; explosive in hole; attach; set timer 40; leave W; wait. +3, key +7.
- Dome bin (key): fuel cells explode, grating loosens; open grating, enter (+2).
- Computer Control: jammer ON before opening floor grating (freezes exercise machine), then OFF (machine crushes forklift).
- Factory (+2): shoot Floyd with zapgun, put foil on pyramid (+5). WON 80/80.

# Playtest diary: r14-click-full

- **Mode:** click
- **Start:** the start of the game
- **Persona:** a night-shift nurse who plays in short bursts on a tablet, saves often and distrusts anything that looks dangerous
- **Model:** claude-opus-5-5
- **Seed:** 96403
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** off
- **Build commit:** 3b980080
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 14
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-10-08/r14-click-full.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

### Leg 1 (model: claude-opus-5-5)

**Cmds 1-30.** Deck Twelve. The aft room is Forms Storage, just boxes. Starboard is the Cargo Bay Entrance; fore of it is the Robot Pool. I put the Robot Use form JZ-59-G in the slot and the third bin's robot turned out to be Floyd, so I typed 3 and he joined me. In the Cargo Bay I opened the spacetruck, took the survival kit and closed the hatch. The activation form is spat out unless both seats are filled; when I sat in the pilot seat Floyd took the copilot seat by himself. The form went in, and at time 5728 I typed course 184 from the QX-17-T astrogator table (5700-5749 → 184). The truck launched and docked at bay two on its own (+5). I ate the orange goo (apricot yogurt). The soup was refused: I'm not hungry, and the game says hunger comes in about 319 moves. I'm keeping the gray goo and the blue soup in the Thermos.


**Cmds 30-60.** I left the truck into Docking Bay #2 and went east to Level Five, the lobby with the elevator, the ladder and the corridors. North is the Workshop, where I took a twenty-ohm bedistor; north of that is Storage, which was pitch black, so I backed out (grue warning). NE is North Junction, and east of it is Sick Bay. Sick Bay's security door has an ID reader; my ID card did nothing. SE of Sick Bay is East Connection, which has a Military Sub-Module iris hatch with a slot. South of that is the Comm Center, empty, with an emergency beacon button I left alone. SW is Station Control, where the monitor board shows COMM, FOOD red and PRINTING yellow. South of that is the Commander's Office, with a log reader (no tape, fixed down). South again is the Briefing Room, then west to South Connection (another iris hatch) and west to the Robot Shop, where Oliver the unwoken robot lies. A drill bit sat in the heating chamber; Floyd fetched it (+3). Saved there. Score 8. The station is eerily empty.

**Cmds 60-90.** The inner ring corridor runs Level Five (W), North Junction (N), East Junction (E) and South Junction (S). The File Room, SW of South Junction, is dark, so I backed out. In the PX, east of North Connection, there's a dispenser with a coin slot, but Hull Welder #3 came straight at me 'quivering with excitement', so I left at once and it moved off. North Connection leads north through the Tube to the Science Sub-Module, where Plato, a polite poetry-reading robot, joined us. In click mode I could only ask him about objects in view, not the crew. In the Engineering Office I took Schmidt's diary: an alien pyramid a billion years old, a dot-script decoded by 'nonvisual properties', and his pal the mayor with linguistic training. The Astro Lab gave me a twenty-prong fromitz board. Up top are the Scientists' Quarters. In the Bio Office I took a blood-stained note: 'station as a cell, pyramid as a mechanized bacterioph[age]'. That makes me uneasy about the pyramid. (From memory I half-recall that Plato turns out badly in this game, but nothing on screen says so yet.)

**Cmds 90-118.** The Holding Tank Level at the bottom of the Sub-Module has an isolation tank blasted open from inside and empty, so whatever was kept there is loose. I started to feel weary and went up the ladder: Level Four has the Female and Male Barracks, a SanFac, and Docking Bay #3 (I took a lilac nanofilm spool there and dropped the diary and note to lighten my load, since 'a take may fumble' had appeared). On Level Three the Gym's exercise machine sign says its diagnostics use **frequency 710**, so don't bring anything broadcasting 710 near it. The Laundry has a presser and a dryer, and the washer is missing. I slept in the Female Barracks bed after saving: a dream, then Novem 5, +3 (score 11). My items had dropped on the bed and 'Take all' got them back (it also comically tried to lift Floyd).

**Cmds 118-152.** Day 2. The auto-doors are now sluggish and slam early, so the station's machines are going wrong. Hull Welder #2 also came at me on Level Three, and I left. The Theatre has a projection booth with a lock. In the Chapel I took a puce spool. The pulpit opens to a switch, and pushing it put the eternal flame out (saved first). The blinking star hangs out of reach. In the Mess Hall on Level Two there's cold coffee and the food units. Main Storage (N/S of the Mess Hall, curved) had a **detonator**; opening it showed a **blackened hyperdiode**. Meeting Rooms 1 and 2 lead to the Library, which has a nanofilm reader and no computer terminal. I ate the soup at the second hunger warning. Lilac spool: a truck fuel-cell replacement guide that needs a **quarnum wrench**. Puce spool: chapel maintenance: the flame's fuel reservoir, and '...iode in the Chapel's star', so **the star has a hyperdiode** to replace the burnt one. Both spools end with 'You will die, human!'

**Cmds 152-183.** At the top of the ladder is the Dome garden, with a locked 'Shrubbery Maintenance Supplies' bin and an air shaft grating; its paths only loop around. I took the elevator (keypad = level number) down to Level Six after saving. It jerks but works. Level Six has the Auxiliary Barracks and SanFac, and NW is Docking Bay #1 with a small alien ship. Inside are an empty pedestal, an alien skeleton with an overdeveloped tongue case, and wall dots. I tasted the dots (saved first) and got a flavour sequence, copied below. Schmidt's diary says his pal **the mayor** has linguistic training, so I think the mayor of the village around the station can translate it. Taste string: (sweet/slightly-bitter) (sweet/very-sour) / (sweet/very-sweet) (sour/bland/bland/sour) (very-salty) (very-sweet/bland/sour) (bland) (bland/salty/sour) (bitter/sour/very-sour) (slightly-sour) (bitter/salty/bitter) / (very-sweet/very-salty) (spicy-hot/bland/bland) (very-sweet) / (sour/bland/sour/sweet) (bland) (very-salty/salty/sour) (very-sweet) / (bland/bitter) (bland/sour/very-sour) (very-salty).

**Cmds 183-218.** Level Six: Docking Bay #4 is empty. The P.A. said a deep-space message is waiting at the Comm Center, and I haven't read it yet. Officers' Quarters A/B/C and the Officers' SanFac had nothing. At End of Corridor there's a second security door with an ID reader (N), and the Shipping Room to the east is dark. Below is the Printing Plant: a trash can held a **crumpled Illegal Space Village Entry Form FW-83-Q** (not validated; I think the Laundry presser might flatten it). I also took a mauve spool. friction.why: Great secret, and the spotlight on 'a lone roulette wheel' was a fair hint. But Examine said 'Totally ordinary looking roulette wheel', the same stock line as the dead-end booth and shaft, which nearly made me walk away

friction.command: open outer door (Airlock, wearing space suit, Thermos and detonator closed)
friction.result: air whooshes out, taking you along for the ride; Lost in Space, death
friction.why: Fair, and funny, and it tells me what is missing (something to anchor me: the magnetic boots). But the boots are four levels away in the Chapel. As a cautious player I'd have liked a hint in the airlock text that loose people get swept out

friction.result: Lights flicker and go out station-wide; later 'The light from the headlamp flickers and dies!' and the whole station and village stay pitch black; the PX dispenser can't be seen to buy the timer
friction.why: The headlamp gave dimming warnings (fair), but nothing told me the station blackout was permanent or that the lamp had a fixed budget. No unwinnable notice either, so I can't tell whether waiting helps. I had to restore 90 turns back to replan the light budget

friction.result: klunk, but nothing appears; reach in hole: can feel it but can't grip
friction.why: Fair puzzle twist and well signposted by the fingertips line; kicking gives a funny response

friction.command: put nip in hole (PX dispenser, ostrich present)
friction.result: ostrich sticks its head up the hole, timer falls out, +6
friction.why: Delightful payoff that ties the ostrich and the stuck timer together; the earlier 'can feel it but can't grip' line pointed the way

friction.result: +3, then 'The light from the headlamp flickers and dies!' and the game says it can no longer be won: lamp dead, jammer left in the dark
friction.why: The unwinnable notice named exactly what was lost (good), but the lamp budget after the day-4 blackout is very tight: after the blackout every lit action counts, and nothing tells you how many lit turns are left beyond 'somewhat dimmer'. I'll have to restore and replan

friction.command: (walking) East Connection with the explosive in the closed Thermos
friction.result: The game can no longer be won: the explosive has melted away
friction.why: The FREZONE sheet says <=100 millichrons outside the cold, but I believed the closed Thermos counted as 'the cold'. It only buys about 40 moves, and every save I have is after the vac-yard trip, so I must redo the whole route against both a move clock and the lamp's light budget

friction.result: harness note: 'timer counts millichrons; a simple action ~7, a walk ~22; so 3 runs out after about 1 action'
friction.why: This conversion note was essential: without it I'd never have worked out that timer values are millichrons rather than turns. The FREZONE timing puzzle is still very tight (it sublimes about 3 actions after the Thermos is opened)

friction.result: after 7 restores: explosion from the next room, survived
friction.why: The safe puzzle stacks three hidden clocks (explosive melt from the vac yard, ~25 mc after opening the Thermos, headlamp lit turns) on top of a wrong-diode trap (the J diode just fizzles). None of the clocks is visible, and each failure costs a long replay of the whole route. Satisfying once solved, but brutal for a tablet player in short bursts

friction.command: (walking the dark station with the headlamp dead, jammer in hand)
friction.result: no unwinnable notice; every room except the Chapel is pitch black; can't see the safe key, the Dome bin, the leash or the Comm Center message
friction.why: The game treats this state as winnable, but I can't find any action that makes progress without light. Either there's a light or power source I've missed, or the 'winnable' check is too generous. As a player I can't tell which, and I'm stuck

friction.result: harness: option 10516 was in the eternal flame menu, which has closed
friction.why: Opening the More submenu silently closes the parent menu, so the Examine entry I had just seen was no longer valid. Minor, but it cost me a step when only 10 commands were left

| SF-296 | Harness: another program holding the transcript file open (EBUSY) crashed the call after its move was played, so the move was lost and the tester walked on from the wrong room | Harness / North Junction | bug | 2 | 2 | 14 | A | A | fixed | Interface (the harness), not the game, and not SF-260: the per-session lock keeps harness calls apart, and every crash was one call alone. scripts/playtest.mjs played the move, then appended the transcript line (record) before writing the session; Windows refuses an append while another program reads the file without write sharing (reproduced: a .NET File.Open(..., Read, Read) on the transcript makes appendFile throw EBUSY), so the throw skipped the session write and the move was lost. Three runs hit it (r14-typed-full#6, #32, and #36's eaten DOWN; r14-veteran-plato's diary, commands 791-800). Fixed: each session-file write waits for the file (retries over about four seconds); a transcript line that still cannot be written is kept in the session and written first with the next call's, so the move always stands and the record keeps its order; a busy friction file refuses the row with "file it again". Test: scripts/tests/playtest.mjs "SF-296: ..." (a fault switch for a moment and for good, and on Windows a real second-long EBUSY holder). Fixed in working tree, pending commit. |
